STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT.exact_target_graph_interface: A simple bipartite graph with variable-side degree 15, clause-side degree 3, no C4, connected/unbounded, deterministic output-polynomial construction, and a separately certified balanced-separator/treewidth lower bound.
STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT.hypergraph_equivalence: Simple C4-free (15,3)-biregular bipartite incidence graph <-> linear 3-uniform 15-regular hypergraph incidence structure.
STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT.sign_layer: After the incidence graph is fixed, deterministically order the 15 incidences at every variable and mark exactly 7 positive and 8 negative; this does not change incidence width.
STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT.linearity_role: A certified sufficient adapter that kills BCE/BVE/R34/RUP obligations cheaply; retaining it avoids reopening reducer-stability proofs.
STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT.minimum_structural_success: tw(G_n)=omega(log n) or an equivalent superlog balanced-separator lower bound.
STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT.preferred_stronger_route: A bounded-degree expander theorem yielding Omega(n) balanced separators/treewidth is acceptable and cleaner if exact graph hypotheses are source-bound.

nodes.source: A. Gribinski, A. W. Marcus, Existence and polynomial time construction of biregular, bipartite Ramanujan graphs of all degrees, arXiv:2108.02534 (2021)
nodes.exact_relevance: For k=5,d=3 their (n,k,d)-graphs have one side degree 3 and the other degree 15, and are constructible in polynomial time for fixed k,d.
nodes.missing_binding: The construction theorem does not supply the simple+C4-free property needed to reuse the certified linear subclass.

nodes.source: M. B. Cohen, Ramanujan Graphs in Polynomial Time, arXiv:1604.03544
nodes.exact_relevance: Confirms the constructive interlacing line is explicitly for Ramanujan (multi)graphs.
nodes.missing_binding: Multigraph output cannot be silently treated as a simple CNF incidence graph.

nodes.source: C. Hall, D. Puder, W. F. Sawin, Ramanujan coverings of graphs, Advances in Mathematics 323 (2018), DOI 10.1016/j.aim.2017.10.042
nodes.exact_relevance: Every r has a Ramanujan covering; Corollary 2.2 preserves simplicity when the common-cover family contains a simple bipartite Ramanujan graph and yields simple (k,l)-biregular Ramanujan graphs in all cover sizes.
nodes.missing_binding: The inspected paper does not give the deterministic output-polynomial selector required by the JANUS replacement-family contract; it explicitly discusses faster construction as a separate issue.

nodes.source: A. Marcus, D. Spielman, N. Srivastava, Interlacing Families I, Annals of Mathematics 182 (2015)
nodes.exact_relevance: Existence of infinite (c,d)-biregular Ramanujan families for all c,d>=3.
nodes.missing_binding: Existence alone does not bind simple C4-free geometry plus output-polynomial selection.

nodes.source: Standard projective Steiner triple system PG(4,2) on 31 points; STS(v) replication number is (v-1)/2.
nodes.exact_relevance: Its Levi graph has point degree 15, block degree 3, is simple and C4-free by the Steiner pair-uniqueness property; it is a finite exact local-geometry seed.
nodes.missing_binding: Its use as the fixed base and its spectral/Ramanujan certificate must be frozen and independently replayed in the next proof lineage.

nodes.source: Hsieh, McKenzie, Mohanty, Paredes, Explicit Two-Sided Unique-Neighbor Expanders, STOC 2024, DOI 10.1145/3618260.3649705
nodes.exact_relevance: Strongly explicit biregular unique-neighbor expansion for sufficiently large degrees.
nodes.missing_binding: The theorem as surfaced does not instantiate the exact small pair (15,3), and C4-free is not automatic.

nodes.source: Chattopadhyay, Gurumukhani, Ringach, Zhao, Two-Sided Lossless Expanders in the Unbalanced Setting, arXiv:2409.04549
nodes.exact_relevance: Explicit two-sided lossless expansion in highly unbalanced settings.
nodes.missing_binding: Degree profile is not source-bound to exact 15/3 and therefore cannot be imported by analogy.

nodes.source: Bottcher, Pruessmann, Taraz, Wurfl, European Journal of Combinatorics 31 (2010), DOI 10.1016/j.ejc.2009.10.010; Dvorak-Norin balanced-separation work
nodes.exact_relevance: Known bridges connect bounded-degree expansion, separators and treewidth.
nodes.missing_binding: Future proof must instantiate an exact expansion/separator constant for the selected graph family; the word expander alone has zero authority.
